origin.description: MD5 hex digest of each string. Missing values stay missing.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A string or a list of strings. None is missing.

origin.details: Text is hashed as UTF-8. A non-string is coerced with R's as.character rules.
origin.value: Hex digests, with None where the input was missing.
